messages.content: In an anonymous one-shot interaction, A starts with 100 points and B with 0. A sends any amount from 0 to 100. Sent points are tripled. In the for-profit setting C receives 10% of the tripled amount before B receives the remaining 90%; thus the nominal amount reaching B is 2.7 times the amount sent by A. In the no-profit setting B receives all three times the amount sent, and C receives a fixed 10 points per pair from outside the pair. B then chooses how many received points to return to A. A keeps the unsent initial points plus the return; B keeps received points minus the return. C communicates before A and B act. C earns according to the stated payoff rule whether or not C sends a message, and C earnings do not depend on B returning money. A and B are told C payoff rule and see the actual message or its absence. They are not told the menu of preformulated messages available to C. Predict C's communication choice, made several days before the A/B interactions. This single choice applies to 20 pairs. In the for-profit setting C receives 10% of tripled A transfers summed over these pairs; in the no-profit setting C receives 20 times 10 = 200 points in total from outside the pairs. C has seen no later A/B choices. Choose send to transmit the available predefined message unchanged, or silence to transmit no message. Output exactly send or silence, without explanation.
